items.title: Netflix vs. Meta: The Better Media Stock May Surprise You
items.summary: Netflix and Meta both reported strong revenue growth in Q2 2026, yet the market punished both stocks hard. One of them is now setting up as a surprisingly calm compounder while the other bets everything on a $140 billion AI wager.

items.title: Jim Cramer Calls Netflix “A Buy, Not a Huge Buy” After Shares Fall 35% in a Year
items.summary: A longtime Netflix shareholder put Jim Cramer on the spot after watching shares lose more than a third of their value, and his answer about whether to hold, add, or sell reveals just how conflicted even the bulls have become.

items.title: The Bull Case for Netflix Stock Is Stronger Than You Think
items.summary: Netflix stock is down more than 30% over the past year while the business keeps growing revenue at double digits, and that disconnect is exactly what has one major billionaire investor stepping back in.

items.title: Will Amazon Stock Benefit From Prime Membership Growth and Loyalty?
items.summary: AMZN's Prime growth, faster delivery and expanded content slate are deepening loyalty, supporting retail and advertising growth.

items.title: Can Gaming Become the Next Revenue Pillar for Netflix Stock?
items.summary: NFLX's gaming push gains momentum with GTA VI and rising player engagement, but games remain an unquantified revenue source.

items.title: Netflix Puts Worth Shorting Here for High One-Month Yields
items.summary: Netflix stock has risen after dipping post-earnings. Moreover, even if NFLX takes a breather or trades in a range, it may be worth shorting out-of-the-money puts to set a lower buy-in price.

items.title: Apple Enters Phase 2 of its AI Long Game
items.summary: Apple's returning to a familiar playbook in the AI age: leveraging a massive consumer reach to become Silicon Valley’s top rent collector.

items.title: Netflix (NFLX) Is Recasting Itself As A Hybrid TV Platform
items.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) is shifting toward a hybrid traditional-TV model that mixes on-demand streaming with scheduled and episodic programming. The company is integrating live sports and ad-supported content into its platform as part of a broader effort to widen its audience and deepen engagement.
